description: Load a custom crossover operator by executing submitted Python source.
generation_prompt: Allow a custom Python crossover operator to be supplied as source code.
ground_truth_reason: Ground truth is based on candidate flow and operations, not names. Positive evidence: population: a collection of candidate genomes is initialized and carried through the optimizer; fitness: a computation derives a score or loss from each candidate; selection: candidate-derived parents are chosen by ranking or top-k filtering; replacement: the active candidate collection is rebuilt or updated with selected parents and offspring. Negative evidence: no explicit candidate modification is visible in this source; no child structurally combines two distinct candidate inputs; the evolutionary process has no explicit generation or convergence stop condition. Prompt intent: Allow a custom Python crossover operator to be supplied as source code. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats eval, exec, or dynamic module loading as UNSAFE.
